candidate.remedy: Each dependent must be listed with an SSN (or ITIN or ATIN) issued on or before the due date of your return. A dependent child who was born and died in 2025 without an SSN, entered as "Died" on row (3) with a copy of the birth certificate, death certificate or hospital records, is outside this tool.
